apps.title: Agent Apps
apps.busy: {{name}} is changing state. Try again when it settles.
apps.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} and its files? It is stopped first, and its data is backed up when it can be.
apps.emptyHint: Press a to add one: install from the marketplace, describe a new one, import one, or connect to one by URL.
apps.buildingStart: Your AI agent is starting the build
apps.agentWorking: your AI agent is working on it
apps.confirmForget: Remove {{name}} from the list? Its files are no longer where they were.
apps.confirmKeepFiles: The framework cannot remove the files of {{name}} safely. Remove it from the list and keep its files?
apps.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{name}}? The app and its data stay on its host.
apps.disconnected: Not connected to your AI agent. The list shows the last known state.
apps.stale: The app list is not current. Wait for it to refresh, or press r.
apps.remoteNoLifecycle: {{name}} runs on another host: it cannot be started or stopped from here
apps.cannotChange: {{name}} cannot be started or stopped right now
apps.waitingAnswers: Waiting for your answers to the builder's questions. Enter opens them.
apps.waitingReview: Waiting for your review of the requirements. Enter opens them.
apps.openBuildHint: Enter opens the build: its progress and the chat with your AI agent
apps.lifecycleFailed: The last start or stop failed
apps.lifecycleUnknown: The connection dropped during the last start or stop. Its result is not known yet.
apps.remaining: Stopped. Work for your AI agent may still be finishing.
apps.missingHint: Its folder is gone. Delete removes it from the list.
apps.unreachableHint: Another program is using its port
apps.registryFailed: The app list could not be read: {{error}}
apps.registryWarning: The app list came with a warning: {{warning}}

hint.confirm: y confirm · any other key cancels

theme.title: Theme for {{name}}
theme.caption: Packs follow the app's light and dark mode. The pick is saved for every client.

build.verifying: Checking the app in a browser

market.installAgain: Already installed. Enter installs another copy.
market.installingHint: Installing. It reports here and as a notice when it is done.
market.progressFailed: Could not check the install progress: {{error}}
market.inspectFailed: This source could not be checked.
market.notInstallable: This app cannot be installed with the toolkits available here.

import.placeholder: https://github.com/user/repo, a folder, or a .zip file
import.hint: Agent App packages (a ZIP, a folder, or a git URL) are installed as they are. Anything else is rebuilt as an Agent App by your AI agent.

wizard.name: Name
wizard.descPlaceholder: What should this app do? Be specific about the data, the workflows and what it must get right.
wizard.newlineHint: Shift+Enter or Ctrl+J for a new line
wizard.iconHint: Left/Right browse, or type any lucide name
wizard.filesPlaceholder: path to a sketch, screenshot or document, then Enter
wizard.pickOne: Pick an option or type an answer first

errors.nameTooLong: The name can be at most 50 characters
errors.descTooShort: Describe it in a little more detail (at least 10 characters)
errors.icon: Not a lucide icon name: use letters and digits, like ShoppingCart

add.title: Add Agent App
add.confirmLeave: Leave Add Agent App? What you typed is lost, and a connection waiting for approval is cancelled.

checkpoint.questionKeys: j/k move · Space pick · Enter continue · Left back · Ctrl+S skip the rest
checkpoint.reviewKeys: j/k scroll · e edit in your editor · a approve · Tab ask for changes
checkpoint.fieldKeys: Enter sends the changes · Tab back to the requirements
checkpoint.changesPlaceholder: what to add, drop or do differently

connect.hint: Connect to an Agent App that is already running somewhere. Its owner approves access on a page that opens in your browser.
connect.waiting: Waiting for approval in your browser. This updates when it is done.
connect.offline: Not connected to your AI agent. Reconnect before connecting an app.
connect.cancelled: The connection was cancelled. You can try again.
